summary: Created/updated styles.css at the repository root with reasonable styling for both pages. The body rule sets a base font stack (Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif), margins (2rem auto), max-width, padding, line-height, and colors (#222 text on #fff background). Added an explicit nav rule (margin-top, padding-top, top border) and an a rule for link color (#1a5fb4), plus nav a rules for spacing and a hover/focus underline so navigation links are visibly styled. Verified: styles.css exists at repo root and is non-empty (453 bytes); regex check confirmed separate rules for body, nav, and a selectors; braces are balanced (6 open / 6 close); confirmed index.html and about.html both link styles.css and cross-link to each other. The repository has no test, lint, or build tooling, so a CSS selector/balance sanity check was the closest available verification. No other files were changed and nothing was committed.
